title: Prize scam: "you won $2.5 million," just pay the fees first

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Congratulations! This is Mark Davis from the National Sweepstakes Bureau. You've won two and a half million dollars and a brand new car!

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Really? I don't remember entering anything.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your name was picked from all the shoppers in Florida. To release the prize, you just need to pay the taxes and processing fee of $1,200 first.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Can't you take the fee out of the prize?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No ma'am, federal rules don't allow that. You can wire it through Western Union today, and we'll deliver the check tomorrow.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Keep this quiet until the check arrives. People get jealous.
